results.name: DataTable

The generic <T> in `columns`/`rows` is resolved per-screen through the row data itself, not through this adapter.

results.name: Toast
reasons: Toast's primary real usage is imperative — a descendant calls the `useToast()` hook (`toast.success(msg)`) returned by ToastProvider's context, not a prop on a tree node. A static ScreenSpec tree can represent a toast already visible on load (Toast's own props are plain and serializable) but cannot represent the runtime trigger — needs a product decision on whether that's an acceptable ScreenSpec fiction or a real gap (candidate Escape).
